_comment: Base importance of each CIM section for buyers, before any industry re-ranking. Keys match CIM_SECTIONS in shared/schema.ts. A supporting agent re-ranks these per deal once the industry is known (server/interview/section-importance.ts); these are the fallback and the floor for the 'critical' set used by completion governance.

overview.reason: Buyers need to understand what the business is before anything else.

financials.reason: Revenue and earnings drive the valuation and every buyer's first screen.

revenue_sources.reason: Buyers price concentration and recurring revenue very differently.

asking_price.reason: Price and terms decide whether a buyer engages at all.

reason_for_sale.reason: Every buyer asks why — a clear answer removes suspicion.

employees.reason: Buyers discount heavily for owner-dependent operations.

operations.reason: Systems and processes show the business runs without the owner.

real_estate.reason: Lease terms can make or break a deal.

target_market.reason: Buyers assess demand durability and customer risk.

growth_potential.reason: Upside is what buyers pay a premium for.

permits_licenses.reason: Transferability of licences affects closing risk.

seasonality.reason: Helps buyers plan cash flow and working capital.

buyer_profile.reason: Helps the broker target the right buyers.
